title: AI 翻译说明 / AI Translation Note
zh: 英文版由 AI 翻译，并由本人校对。看太多英文会让我头疼，所以校对会慢慢进行。译文不是最终版本，可能随时更改。
我并不担心 AI 翻译会篡改我的意思，让作品不再纯净。我相信 AI 是天然带有无产阶级属性的创作工具。就像我一样，它也站在巨人的肩膀上，把前人的思想化作自己的。AI 也只是拟合语言与词语的工具；在本质上，我并不比 AI 更高明。
不过，我已经对 AI 译文进行了多轮校对，以确保它紧密遵循中文原文的意象与节奏。
en: The English editions are translated by AI and reviewed by me. Reading too much English gives me a headache, so I will work through them slowly. These translations are not final and may change at any time.

I am not concerned that AI translation will distort what I mean or make the work less pure. I believe AI is a creative tool with an inherently proletarian character. Like me, it stands on the shoulders of giants and turns the thoughts of those who came before into its own. AI, too, is simply a tool that fits language and words together. I am not, in essence, more brilliant than AI.
Even so, I have reviewed the AI translations many times to ensure that they closely follow the imagery and cadence of the original Chinese.
